lines.en: label halloweentwo3:
scene letspartygogogo1
Sana and I make it to the party just as things seem to start picking up, and she quickly seizes the opportunity to slip away from me without saying anything.
lines.zh: 我和Sana赶到派对时，气氛才刚开始热起来，她立刻抓住机会，一声不吭地从我身边溜走了。

lines.en: Thanks, Sana. I really appreciate that after our long and memorable journey to the Amamiya mansion together.
lines.zh: 谢了啊，Sana。在我们一起经历了那段漫长又难忘的通往天宫宅邸的旅程之后，我真是感激不尽。

lines.en: : Umm...Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嗯……Sensei？

lines.en: : Oh. You’re still here after all.
lines.zh: : 哦。你原来还在啊。

lines.en: Nevermind. Sana is just apparently so short that when I turned around to see if she was still there, I must have looked over her head.
lines.zh: 当我没说。Sana显然个子太矮了，我回头看她还在不在的时候，视线一定是从她头顶掠过去的。

lines.en: : I’m...gonna go...{i}not{/i} hang out with you anymore...
lines.zh: : 我……要去……{i}不再{/i}跟你待在一起了……

lines.en: Nevermind again. It appears that Sana has been gone this entire time and that what I heard just now was nothing but a whisper in the wind.
lines.zh: 再次当我没说。看来Sana从头到尾都已经走掉了，我刚才听到的不过是风中的一句低语。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo2
: Yo! Sensei! Over here!
lines.zh: : 哟！Sensei！这边！

lines.en: : Oh, good. Someone who actually cares about me.
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了。总算有个真的在乎我的人。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo3
: Yo. Figured it was only a matter of time until the token adult showed up.
lines.zh: : 哟。我就知道，那个挂名大人迟早会露面。

lines.en: : Yes, it is I. The token adult. Here to tell everyone to abstain from consuming alcohol and to be sure to check in with their parents every hour.
lines.zh: : 正是在下。挂名大人。来这儿是为了告诉大家不要喝酒，以及每小时跟父母报备一次。

lines.en: : Otoha checked in when we got here, so you don’t have to worry about that part at all.
lines.zh: : Otoha我们到的时候就报备过了，所以那部分你完全不用担心。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo4
: Uh...yeah. But I don’t have to check in again until the party is over, so...lay off for now.
lines.zh: : 呃……对。不过在派对结束之前我都不用再报备，所以……现在先别管我。

lines.en: : Will do.
lines.zh: : 遵命。

lines.en: : So...how are {i}things{/i} with you two?
lines.zh: : 那么……你们两个{i}怎么样{/i}？

lines.en: : Any noteworthy hiccups in the relationship or obstacles worth mentioning as of late?
lines.zh: : 最近感情上有什么值得一提的波折或者障碍吗？

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo5
I manage to discreetly insert myself into their lovelife and attempt to uncover whether Rin’s recent mistakes have been uncovered or not.
lines.zh: 我成功地不动声色地把话题插进了她们的恋爱生活，试图探明Rin最近的那些失误有没有被发现。

lines.en: And while Rin’s look right now may be screaming, “Why would you ask that?” I’m sure her heart is thanking me for checking in on her in such a mature and inconspicuous manner.
lines.zh: 虽然Rin现在的表情分明在尖叫“你干嘛问这个？”，但我敢肯定她的内心在感谢我以如此成熟而不露痕迹的方式关心她。

lines.en: You’re welcome, Rin.
lines.zh: 不用谢，Rin。

lines.en: : Things are...pretty great, actually.
lines.zh: : 状况……其实挺不错的。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo6
: It’s not really all that different from how things were beforehand.
lines.zh: : 跟之前也没什么太大区别。

lines.en: : We just see each other more often and...say more cute things, I guess?
lines.zh: : 只是我们见面的次数变多了，还有……会说更多可爱的话吧？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’m not really good at that part.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。我本来就不太擅长那部分。

lines.en: : Well...we’re taking it slow, right? There’s no need to get good at {i}any{/i} part until you feel good {i}about{/i} it!
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们不是说了要慢慢来吗？在你觉得舒服之前，没必要把{i}哪一部分{/i}练熟！

lines.en: : I mean...you can say as much cute stuff as you want. That doesn’t bother me.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你想说多少可爱的话都行。那个我不介意。

lines.en: : It’s the whole “forcing yourself on me and kissing me before I have a chance to breathe” that I want to avoid.
lines.zh: : 我想避免的是“趁我还没喘过气就强行压上来亲我”那部分。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo7
: But you look so kissable! Especially in your bloodsoaked dress!
lines.zh: : 可你看起来太好亲了！尤其是穿着那条血淋淋的裙子！

lines.en: : I want to kiss you right now!
lines.zh: : 我现在就想亲你！

lines.en: : Don’t mind me. I’m fine with watching.
lines.zh: : 别管我。我就看着就好。

lines.en: : For real, though...this has been a lot easier than I expected it to be.
lines.zh: : 不过说真的……这比我预想的要轻松多了。

lines.en: : Not that I thought it would be difficult or anything, it’s just...
lines.zh: : 不是说我觉得会有多难什么的，只是……

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo8
: Well...Rin is {i}Rin{/i}, you know? Making things weird and uncomfortable is what she does best.
lines.zh: : 嗯……{i}Rin{/i}就是Rin，你知道吧？把事情搞得又怪又尴尬是她最擅长的。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...
: She’s just been...really chill so far.
lines.zh: : 她到目前为止……一直都挺淡定的。

lines.en: : Not really sure what else I can say without turning this into some mushy love fest which, given that you're our teacher, would be a pretty weird situation for all of us.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道还能说什么，才不至于把气氛变成黏糊糊的恋爱秀——毕竟你是我们老师，那对我们所有人来说都挺怪的。

lines.en: So, it appears that my probing into [kumon_mi_high]’s newest romantic companionship has been successful in that everyone involved is feeling entirely comfortable and not out of place in any way.
lines.zh: 看来，我对 [kumon_mi_high] 最新一对恋人的试探颇为成功——所有相关人员都感到完全自在，丝毫没有不协调的地方。

lines.en: Just kidding, obviously.
lines.zh: 显然是开玩笑的。

lines.en: I’ve clearly made Rin uncomfortable, but if she’s ever going to get adjusted to lying to the people she cares about, this is something she’ll be forced to handle from time to time.
lines.zh: 我显然让Rin不自在了，但如果她终究要学会对自己在乎的人撒谎，那这就是她时不时必须面对的事。

lines.en: All things considered, I think she’s doing pretty well.
lines.zh: 综合考虑，我觉得她做得还不错。

lines.en: It’s like Otoha has absolutely no idea that beneath Rin’s costume lies symbol after symbol of a pain so great that not even freshly blossoming love can repair it.
lines.zh: Otoha似乎完全不知道，在Rin的变装服之下，藏着一个又一个象征着深重痛苦的印记——那份痛苦之深，连刚刚萌芽的爱情都无法修补。

lines.en: : So, I saw Futaba with Molly, but where’s Nodoka? Isn’t she normally with you two?
lines.zh: : 对了，我看到Futaba和Molly在一起，可Nodoka呢？她平时不是跟你们两个一起的吗？

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo9
: Oh, Nodoka’s not coming.
lines.zh: : 哦，Nodoka不来了。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo10
: Beats me. But I feel like you might be able to figure out the answer if you ask this mysterious, yet extremely familiar stranger who just showed up.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。不过我觉得，你要是问问这位神秘的、却又极其眼熟的刚出现的陌生人，大概就能得到答案。

lines.en: : Hah...
scene letspartygogogo11
: Sup, homie.
lines.zh: : 哟，老兄。

lines.en: : Nodoka...why?
lines.zh: : Nodoka……为什么？

lines.en: : That’s not Nodoka. That’s Rin Rokuhara, everyone’s favorite bisexual barista.
lines.zh: : 那不是Nodoka。那是六原Rin，大家最爱的双性恋咖啡师。

lines.en: : Dicks are weird. Let’s go listen to My Chemical Romance and play Halo.
lines.zh: : 鸡巴真奇怪。我们去听 My Chemical Romance，打光晕吧。

lines.en: : She sounds just like me.
lines.zh: : 她说话跟我一模一样。

lines.en: : Interesting costume choice.
lines.zh: : 变装服选得挺有意思。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo12
: I thought it might be entertaining to make Otoha’s life a living hell for a day, so I’ve been trying to trick her into thinking I’m her girlfriend since she woke up.
lines.zh: : 我想，让Otoha这一天过得像地狱一样应该挺好玩的，所以从她起床开始，我就一直在骗她以为我是她女朋友。

lines.en: : You two have completely different colored hair...I’m not going to fall for that.
lines.zh: : 你们两个头发颜色完全不一样……我不会上当的。

lines.en: : As you can tell, my experiment hasn’t exactly yielded the results I was hoping for.
lines.zh: : 如你所见，我的实验并没有得到我期望的结果。

lines.en: : I will say, though. I feel quite adventurous wearing another girl’s underwear.
lines.zh: : 不过我得说，穿着另一个女生的内裤，感觉还挺刺激的。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo13
: You let her borrow your underwear too?...
lines.zh: : 你连内裤都借给她了？……

lines.en: : Is that bad? I liked her idea and wanted the experience to be as authentic as possible.
lines.zh: : 这不好吗？我喜欢她的主意，想让这次体验尽可能地原汁原味。

lines.en: : It’s the first time anyone’s ever tried to dress like me. I was just doing what needed to be done.
lines.zh: : 这是第一次有人试图打扮成我的样子。我只是做了该做的事。

lines.en: : Dude...
lines.zh: : 老兄……

lines.en: : That does look surprisingly good on you, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 你穿这身意外地好看啊，Nodoka。

lines.en: : Doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是吧？

lines.en: : Plus, if I lose my virginity while dressed as Rin, it won’t count because I’m not {i}actually{/i} Nodoka right now.
lines.zh: : 再说了，要是我扮成Rin的时候丢掉处女之身，那就不算数，因为我现在{i}其实{/i}不是Nodoka。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo14
: That is absolutely not how that works!
lines.zh: : 这绝对不是那么算的！

lines.en: : It’s not?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : Sensei, if you’re going to have sex with Nodoka while she’s wearing my clothes, can you make sure you take her underwear off first and not just do that thing where it’s slid to the side?
lines.zh: : Sensei，如果你要跟穿着我衣服的Nodoka做爱，能不能先把她内裤脱下来，别只是拨到一边？

lines.en: : I want them back, but not if they have teacher juice all over them.
lines.zh: : 我还想要回来呢，但可不想上面沾满老师的汁液。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo15
: You’re not getting them back either way! I’m exercising my right as your girlfriend to not let you share underwear with people!
lines.zh: : 你怎么样都拿不回来了！我要行使作为你女朋友的权利，不许你跟别人共用内裤！

lines.en: : What?! Can I at least have my pantyhose back?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！那至少把我的连裤袜还给我？！

lines.en: : Stop letting my roommate transform into you!
lines.zh: : 别再让我室友变成你了！

lines.en: : People keep talking and not giving me the chance to agree to having sex with you.
lines.zh: : 大家一直在说，都不给我机会答应跟你做爱。

lines.en: : Shame. If you’d responded several seconds earlier, I would have actually considered it.
lines.zh: : 可惜。你要是早几秒答应的话，我说不定真会考虑。

lines.en: : No you wouldn’t. I’m calling your bluff this time, Rindoka Nagahara.
lines.zh: : 你才不会。这次我揭你的底，凛乃花·永原。

lines.en: : Thinking I’m bluffing will just make it more exciting when you don’t realize I’ve stopped.
lines.zh: : 以为我在虚张声势，只会让你在我真的停下来时更兴奋——因为你根本察觉不到。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo16
: Okay, you need to leave now. This has gotten too weird and I need to have a talk with these two.
lines.zh: : 好了，你现在可以走了。这已经太怪了，我得跟这两个人谈谈。

lines.en: : Are you sure? Because it looks like Nodoka and Rin have formed an alliance and you might need someone on your side.
lines.zh: : 你确定？看起来Nodoka和Rin已经结盟了，你可能需要有人站你这边。

lines.en: : I am sure I’ll manage. Bye, now.
lines.zh: : 我确定我能搞定。再见啦。

lines.en: : Suit yourself. But don’t come crying to me when you have no idea whose underwear you’re taking off later.
lines.zh: : 随你。不过等会儿你不知道自己在脱谁的内裤时，可别来找我哭。

lines.en: scene black
I leave one of the contenders for “the most sexually charged table at the Halloween party” and make my way over to a small group with a slightly lower combined libido.
lines.zh: 我离开了“万圣节派对上性张力最强桌子”的候选之一，走向一个合计性欲稍低的小团体。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo17
: What is this? Hath the threads of fate pulled you through the planes of desolation and into the arms of the Prinzessin?
lines.zh: : 这是什么？难道命运之线把你拽过荒芜的位面，送进了审判公主的怀抱？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Hey, Sensei...We were just wondering when you were going to show up.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sensei……我们刚才还在想你什么时候才会露面。

lines.en: : I’ve been here for a little while now, but I’ve just been banished from one of the four tables at the party, so...
lines.zh: : 我已经来了一会儿了，只不过刚被从派对四张桌子中的一张流放出来，所以……

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo18
: Already? What is this, GDQ?
lines.zh: : 已经？这是什么，GDQ 吗？

lines.en: : Are you attempting to speedrun the Halloween party, Sir?
lines.zh: : 您是打算速通这场万圣节派对吗，先生？

lines.en: : Potentially. Though, I’m not sure if there’s anything I could say that would cause either of you two to get rid of me.
lines.zh: : 有可能。不过我不确定自己能说出什么话，会让你们两个当中的任何一个赶我走。

lines.en: : I’m...sure there are a few things. But that mostly seems right...
lines.zh: : 我……想应该有几句。不过大体上好像是对的……

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo19
: Maybe Molly and I just like you more than everyone else here?
lines.zh: : 也许只是我和Molly比这里其他所有人都更喜欢你？

lines.en: : Futaba...you’re not actually flirting with me right now, are you?
lines.zh: : Futaba……你现在该不会真的在跟我调情吧？

lines.en: : I’m not...{i}not{/i} flirting with you?
lines.zh: : 我也没……{i}没{/i}在跟你调情？

lines.en: : Careful, Sir. Legends say that this Adeptus once defeated a giant monster in the Archon War with nothing but her behind. The next monster could very well be you.
lines.zh: : 小心点，先生。传说这位仙众曾在魔神战争中用她的臀部打败过一只巨兽。下一只巨兽很可能就是你。

lines.en: : If that’s how I’m meant to go, so be it.
lines.zh: : 如果那就是我命定的死法，那就这样吧。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo20
: I...don’t have any plans to kill you, Sensei...Let alone in...that way...
lines.zh: : 我……没打算杀你，Sensei……更别说用……那种方式了……

lines.en: I feel slightly disappointed by this news, but ultimately accept that I must continue living for the time being.
lines.zh: 我对这个消息感到有点失望，但最终还是接受了——我暂时必须继续活下去。

lines.en: : Sir, while you’re here, may I trouble you for some assistance in what I have deemed a rather disappointing matter?
lines.zh: : 先生，既然你在这儿，能不能麻烦您在一件我认为相当令人失望的事情上帮个忙？

lines.en: : That depends on what kind of assistance you need and how disappointing the matter is.
lines.zh: : 那得看你需要什么样的帮忙，以及这件事有多令人失望。

lines.en: : Molly...wants me to drink with her.
lines.zh: : Molly……想让我陪她喝酒。

lines.en: : What? Was last year not a big enough sign that drinking at parties might not really be your thing?
lines.zh: : 什么？去年那次还不够说明——在派对上喝酒可能真的不适合你吗？

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo21
: Last year was a mistake! I have grown since then!
lines.zh: : 去年是个错误！从那以后我已经成长了！

lines.en: : Not physically, of course. I appear to have stagnated right near the cusp of lolidom. But mentally, Sir! I am ready to drink once more!
lines.zh: : 当然不是身体上的。我似乎停滞在了萝莉领域的边缘。但在精神上，先生！我已经准备好再喝一次了！

lines.en: : Well, I’m not going to stop you. But there’s no point in dragging Futaba into it if she doesn’t want to.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不打算拦你。不过要是Futaba不愿意，也没必要把她拖下水。

lines.en: : She is my last hope, Sir! The Kendo Princess is allergic to alcohol, Rin hates me, and the girls from your domain never want to partake either!
lines.zh: : 她是我最后的希望，先生！剑道公主对酒精过敏，Rin讨厌我，而您领地里的姑娘们也从来不想参与！

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo22
: Rin doesn’t {i}hate{/i} you, Molly...she cares about you a lot...
lines.zh: : Rin不{i}讨厌{/i}你，Molly……她其实很在乎你……

lines.en: : She just needs a little time to focus on other things right now...It’s nothing personal.
lines.zh: : 她只是现在需要点时间专注别的事情……不是针对你。

lines.en: : By royal decree, cease this irrelevant clamor and partake in the festivities of this Hallowed festival before our descent into the Immernachtreich.
lines.zh: : 以王命之名，停止这无谓的喧哗，在我们坠入永夜帝国之前，参与这神圣节日的庆典吧。

lines.en: : Drink with me so I can feel less lonely and not pressured to go talk to her.
lines.zh: : 陪我喝吧，这样我就不会那么孤单，也不用被逼着去跟她说话。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo23
: Hah...
Suddenly, I get the feeling that this might be a rather depressing Halloween compared to the last one.
lines.zh: 突然间，我有种预感——比起去年，今年这个万圣节可能会相当令人沮丧。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo24
: I’ll drink with you, Molly!
lines.zh: : 我陪你喝，Molly！

lines.en: Suddenly, that feeling is validated.
lines.zh: 突然间，这个预感被证实了。

lines.en: : You?
: But we have barely exchanged dialogue with one another. I wouldn’t know the first thing about communicating with you.
lines.zh: : 可我们几乎没怎么交谈过。我连该怎么跟你沟通都不知道。

lines.en: : Do you know the first thing about communicating with...anyone?
lines.zh: : 你知道该怎么跟……任何人沟通吗？

lines.en: : Well, that’s what the alcohol is for. We can let {i}that{/i} do the talking.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}那{/i}不就是酒的作用嘛。我们让酒来替我们说话。

lines.en: : Have I mentioned how hot you look, by the way? I have no idea what you’re supposed to be, but I love it.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，我说过你看起来有多辣吗？我不知道你扮的是什么，但我超喜欢。

lines.en: : Oh...umm...thank you?
lines.zh: : 哦……呃……谢谢？

lines.en: : Were you just listening in on our conversation or something, Kirin? It’s strange for you to just...jump in like that.
lines.zh: : 你刚才是不是在偷听我们说话，Kirin？你这样突然……插进来真奇怪。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo25
: Does it matter? Molly wants to drink. I want to drink. I see no issue with this.
lines.zh: : 有关系吗？Molly想喝。我想喝。我看不出有什么问题。

lines.en: : Besides, I’ve been sneaking stuff out of my parents’ alcohol cabinet since middle[school]. I’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我从中学起就偷我爸妈酒柜里的东西了。我不会有事的。

lines.en: : It’s...not {i}you{/i} we’re really worried about...
lines.zh: : 我们真正担心的……不是{i}你{/i}……

lines.en: : Senseiiiii~ Are you really trying to rob me of what could be my only opportunity to see the drunk Molly I heard about at your last Halloween party?
lines.zh: : 老师~~~~你该不会真想剥夺我唯一的机会，让我看不到你上次万圣节派对上那个喝醉的Molly吧？

lines.en: : I’m more or less trying to prevent the arrival of an ambulance in the near future because I know you’ll push her to her limits.
lines.zh: : 我大体上是想阻止不久的将来开来一辆救护车，因为我知道你会把她逼到极限。

lines.en: : That’s just the type of person you are.
lines.zh: : 你就是那种人。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo26
: Is it?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: Kirin pushes through Molly and Futaba and presses herself up against me.
lines.zh: Kirin挤过Molly和Futaba，把身子贴到我身上。

lines.en: And, as much as I’d like to go along with it, there are almost twenty other girls in this room right now who this could start problems with.
lines.zh: 虽然我也很想顺着她来，但这屋里还有将近二十个女孩，这可能会惹出麻烦。

lines.en: : Hey, you haven’t complimented my costume yet. How come?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你还没夸我的变装服呢。为什么？

lines.en: : I thought you’d like something like this. You know...naughty[school]girl and all that.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你会喜欢这种的。你知道的……坏坏的[school]妹什么的。

lines.en: : Yes. I was unaware up until this very moment that you could be considered one of those. Well thought out costume, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 是的。直到这一刻我才意识到，你居然也能算其中之一。变装服考虑得很周到，Kirin。

lines.en: : Hey, here’s an idea~
lines.zh: : 嘿，我有个主意~

lines.en: : How about you...and me...{i}and{/i} Molly go get drunk together? Somewhere private.
lines.zh: : 不如你……我……{i}还有{/i}Molly，一起去喝个烂醉？找个没人的地方。

lines.en: : It’s a party, right? Doesn’t that sound fun, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 这是派对嘛，对吧？听起来很有趣吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : If this is how it looks to be a protagonist, I am glad that I’m just a heroine.
lines.zh: : 如果当主角是这个样子，我很庆幸自己只是个女主角。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo27
: Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 哦豁。

lines.en: : Come onnnn~ Why are you being all quiet?
lines.zh: : 来嘛~~~~干嘛这么安静？

lines.en: : You know you want to.
lines.zh: : 你知道你想要的。

lines.en: : Is it just cause there are other girls around?
lines.zh: : 就因为有别的女孩在？

lines.en: : Cause I know a way for us to slip away and really start getting to the good part of-
lines.zh: : 我知道一条路，可以让我们溜走，直接进入——

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo28
: ...the night.
lines.zh: : ……夜晚的正题。

lines.en: : Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 哦豁。

lines.en: : Do you think it’s okay to just go around putting your hands on people like that?
lines.zh: : 你觉得就这么到处把手往别人身上放，合适吗？

lines.en: : I mean...
lines.zh: : 我意思是……

lines.en: : Isn’t that what you’re doing to me right now?...
lines.zh: : 你现在不也正对我做同样的事吗？……

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo29
: Funny.
lines.zh: : 真好笑。

lines.en: : Now, get off of him. He clearly isn't enjoying it.
lines.zh: : 现在，从他身上下来。他明显并不享受。

lines.en: : What are you even supposed to be?
lines.zh: : 你又扮的是什么？

lines.en: : Hotter than you. Now go run along and convince someone who actually {i}wants{/i} to be around you to get drunk instead of our teacher.
lines.zh: : 比你辣。现在乖乖走开，去说服一个真的{i}想{/i}跟你在一起的人喝醉，别来烦我们老师。

lines.en: : Wait, were you listening to our conversation as-
lines.zh: : 等等，你刚才是在偷听我们——

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo30
: Hey, Sensei! I didn’t even see you there! Haha!
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sensei！我都没看到你在那儿！哈哈！

lines.en: : But...you just-
lines.zh: : 可是……你刚刚——

lines.en: : Would you mind coming with me for a second? There’s something I have to talk to you about in private.
lines.zh: : 介意跟我来一下吗？我有点事得单独跟你谈。

lines.en: : Uhh...okay?
scene letspartygogogo31
: Wha-
: What the fuck just happened?
lines.zh: : 刚才到底发生了什么？

lines.en: : Chika OP. Please nerf.
lines.zh: : Chika太强了。求削弱。

lines.en: scene black
scene letspartygogogo32
: You don’t actually have anything you need to talk about, do you?
lines.zh: : 你其实没什么要谈的，对吧？

lines.en: : Nope! I just didn’t like watching that little slut put her hands on you.
lines.zh: : 没有！我只是不喜欢看着那个小骚货把手往你身上放。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo33
: Like, really though! Who does she think she is dressing up like that? You can straight up see her bra. It’s barely even a costume.
lines.zh: : 说真的！她以为自己是谁啊，穿成那样？你都能直接看到她的胸罩了。那根本算不上变装服。

lines.en: : In her defense, your costume is a little more...revealing.
lines.zh: : 替她说句公道话，你的变装服还要更……暴露一点。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo34
: True. But it’s not like you haven’t already seen me naked, soooo...I see no problem. Do you?
lines.zh: : 没错。可你也不是没看过我光着的样子，所以……我看没问题。你呢？

lines.en: : Not...really.
lines.zh: : 没……什么问题。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo35
: Oh! You didn’t see Yumi on the way over, did you?
lines.zh: : 哦！你过来的路上没看到Yumi吧？

lines.en: : I know you came with Sana, so I’m not sure if you like, bumped into her on the way and knew if she was coming or not.
lines.zh: : 我知道你是跟Sana一起来的，所以不确定你会不会在路上撞见她，知不知道她来不来。

lines.en: : Why not just text her?
lines.zh: : 为什么不直接发短信问她？

lines.en: : I’ve obviously texted her already if I’m asking you, Sensei. She just didn’t respond and I want to make sure she’s not being a brat again.
lines.zh: : 我要是没发过，就不会问你了，Sensei。她只是没回，我想确认她是不是又在耍性子。

lines.en: : Maybe she’s just...taking longer than normal to change into her costume?
lines.zh: : 也许她只是……换变装服比平时慢？

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo36
: Yeah, I’m sure her “Antisocial [teenage]birthday girl” costume is a lot harder to put on than my...gypsy dancer or whatever this outfit is supposed to be.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我敢肯定她那套“反社会[teenage]生日女孩”的变装服，比我这套……吉普赛舞娘还是什么的难穿多了。

lines.en: : You don’t even know?
lines.zh: : 你连自己扮的是什么都不知道？

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo37
: Nope. I just saw it at the Halloween store and thought it might make you horny, so I bought it.
lines.zh: : 不知道。我就是在万圣节商店看到它，觉得可能会让你硬，就买了。

lines.en: : Ahh, yes. A respectable strategy.
lines.zh: : 啊，是啊。很体面的策略。

lines.en: : Is it working?
lines.zh: : 奏效了吗？

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo38
: How would you like to find- actually, nevermind. Hold that thought.
lines.zh: : 你想怎么验——算了，当我没说。这个念头先留着。

lines.en: : Awwww boo~
lines.zh: : 啊———真没劲~

lines.en: : Um...do...do you have a sec?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你……你有空吗？

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo39
: Yeah. This is the part where everyone comes up to me and says hi, so say your piece now while you still have the screen time.
lines.zh: : 有啊。现在是所有人轮番上来跟我打招呼的环节，趁你还有镜头，赶紧说吧。

lines.en: : Oh. My. God.
lines.zh: : 哦。我的。天。
: 那是……那是……那是……

lines.en: : Is that...Niki’s actual...stage outfit from the “Be My Fire” tour?
lines.zh: : 那难道是……Niki真正的……“Be My Fire”巡演的舞台服？

lines.en: : Oh...yeah. She let me borrow it for Halloween.
lines.zh: : 哦……对。她借给我过万圣节穿的。

lines.en: : Niki wore {i}that{/i}?
lines.zh: : Niki穿过{i}这个{/i}？

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo40
: Yes! But only {i}three{/i} times before it was discontinued for being too out of line with what her production company wanted her image to be!
lines.zh: : 穿过！但只穿了{i}三{/i}次，就因为和她经纪公司想要的形象太不符而停用了！

lines.en: : It’s super, {i}super{/i} rare! Like, you can’t even find videos of it online anymore because they were all taken down!
lines.zh: : 超级、{i}超级{/i}稀有！网上连视频都找不到了，全被下架了！

lines.en: : Then...how do you even know about it?
lines.zh: : 那……你是怎么知道的？

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo41
: Never underestimate a true fan, Sensei. I know everything about Niki. {i}Everything.{/i}
lines.zh: : 永远别小看一个真粉丝，Sensei。关于Niki的事我什么都知道。{i}全部{/i}。

lines.en: I doubt you know that she’s a virgin who I recently fingered in a hotel room.
lines.zh: 我怀疑你并不知道，她是个处女，而且我最近在酒店房间里用手指弄过她。

lines.en: But that’s good. Because if you did know that, both of us would likely be dead.
lines.zh: 不过这样很好。因为如果你知道，我们俩大概都已经死了。

lines.en: : Uh...sorry to kill the mood and stuff, but is it okay for me to steal Sensei for a minute or two?
lines.zh: : 呃……抱歉扫兴什么的，我能借用Sensei一两分钟吗？

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo42
: Aww! But I just got him!
lines.zh: : 啊！可我刚抢到他！

lines.en: : It won’t be long...I just have to ask him something.
lines.zh: : 不会很久……我只是有点事要问他。

lines.en: : Can you not just ask it here?
lines.zh: : 不能在这儿问吗？

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo43
: I’m sorry. It needs to be in private.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。得私下说。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}Do you accept this invitation, Sensei?
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}你接受这个邀请吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I accept this invitation, Chika. Thank you for becoming my new, unofficial secretary. Please don’t tell Makoto.
lines.zh: : 我接受这个邀请，Chika。谢谢你成为我的新任非正式秘书。请别告诉Makoto。

lines.en: : Just...okay. Yeah. Whatever.
lines.zh: : 行……吧。好。随便你。

lines.en: : I’ll...let you know if I hear back from Yumi.
lines.zh: : 要是听到Yumi的消息，我会……告诉你的。

lines.en: scene letspartygogogo44
Chika disappears back into the crowd of party goers, leaving Noriko and me on the outskirts of the room, seemingly unnoticed by everyone else for the time being.
lines.zh: Chika消失回派对人群里，留下Noriko和我待在房间边缘，暂时似乎没人注意到我们。

lines.en: I’m not really sure what this could be about, but she definitely looks a little more serious than normal.
lines.zh: 我不太确定这会是什么事，但她看起来确实比平时严肃一些。

lines.en: So...whatever the problem is, I hope it’s nothing big.
lines.zh: 所以……不管问题是什么，希望不是什么大事。

lines.en: : Come outside with me for a sec.
lines.zh: : 跟我出来一下。

lines.en: : Oh. Sure.
lines.zh: : 哦。好。
